=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: `PR_CHECKS_JQ_SUPERSEDE_DEFS`, CI-name branch of `_mark_superseded` (the `(if ($ci != "" ... ((.[0].name // "") == $ci)) then ...)` arm) | severity not stated | confidence not stated
  PROBLEM: When `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK` names a non-Actions CI provider, every run in the group has a null `_run_id`, so the same-run / bound-CI supersession paths are both dead and the cancelled run keeps blocking the merge until the head changes.
  WHY: The suggested fallback is limited to groups where no run has an Actions run ID; the reviewer classifies this as a hardening opportunity rather than a correctness defect.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:Lines 107, 113-119 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The configured-CI supersession filter assumes every check-run named by `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK` has an Actions run URL.
  WHY: With a configured non-Actions CI check, `capture` errors on its details URL. The jq filter then produces no numeric blocking count, so `_pr_checks_completed` returns `query_failed` and refuses the merge even when the check succeeded. This affects the documented name-only mode when `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS=none`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:Lines 107-119 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The configured-CI supersession path only recognizes check runs with `/actions/runs/<id>` URLs.
  WHY: When `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK` is set to a check name that comes from a non-Actions source, `_run_id` returns null and the run is not in `PR_CHECKS_CI_RUN_IDS`, so a newer successful run cannot supersede an older cancelled run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
